items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: His name floats... I used to try to spell his name. One day I spelled it. He said no, because his name is not spelled the way that it sounds.

ctx.x: You asked me once before, and I jumped right up and answered you. His name floats.
Yeah, Billy is his first name. But he had this – but his last name was – I used to try to spell his name. One day I spelled it. He said no, because his name is not spelled the way that it sounds.
